svg.aria-label: The path of a manuscript through the modes of the paper skill. /paper plan: Help me plan my paper: a chapter plan, worked out in a dialogue | /paper full: one run does every part, in this order: 1. The literature search. Alone: /paper lit-review; 2. The outline. Alone: /paper outline-only; 3. The arguments and the draft. Only in full mode; 4. The figures. Alone: /paper figures, a call; 5. The citation check. Alone: /paper citation-check; 6. The abstract. Alone: /paper abstract-only; 7. The review of the draft. Alone: /paper draft-review, a call; 8. The format and the cover letter. Alone: /paper format-convert; 9. The AI disclosure statement. Alone: /paper disclosure | You submit: /submit: Write the highlights; Describe a graphical abstract | /paper revision: one run does every part, in this order: 1. The comments read into a list of items. Alone, as a roadmap: /paper revision-coach; 2. The manuscript revised, and the citations of the changes checked. Only in revision mode; 3. The response letter and its check, for referee comments. Alone: /paper response-letter | You resubmit: /submit: A response you wrote yourself, checked before you send it: /paper rebuttal-audit | Internal documents: A record of every attempt, for my own reference: /paper full, outline-only or abstract-only, with the intake row Internal only set to yes; An outline or a literature review to pass to my co-authors: /paper outline-only or /paper lit-review.

svg.text: Full mode's intake offers the latest plan run (chapter-plan.md, insights.md, dialogue.md) and the latest lit-review run (review.md, refs.bib), so work done alone is not done
